# iliad-071 (Iliad 11.804–848) — review, pass 1

Method: notes checked label by label against the line; Greek → `l` word by word; `l` ↔ `i`; remembered English; quotation marks; published repeats; house table (Iliad and Odyssey) grepped for every formula and epithet. `t` untouched (checked unit by unit against the original). Scansion flags: none, so no hand-scan was due.

Severity: high = wrong fact or wrong sense; medium = contradicts the house table, a false claim in a note, or remembered English; low = wording, consistency, hedging.

## Checked and found sound

- Quotation marks: iliad-070 ends with ” on 802–803 (Nestor), so 804 correctly opens without a mark. Patroclus 816–821: “ on 816, ” on 819's unit (`l` and `i`); `mark` on 816. Eurypylus 823–836: “ on 823, ” on 836, `mark` on 823. Patroclus 838–841: “ on 838, ” on 841, `mark` on 838. Reply-formula units 822, 837 carry no marks; ¶ units 804, 822, 837, 842 carry `p`.
- Published repeats: 11.815 (`l` line 4 and `i` of iliad-035) reused exactly in unit 814. 11.804: `l` reused with comma, `i` with Patroclus for Machaon; the unit is not the whole published unit (it runs into 805), so identity is not required.
- All other table-governed items agree: διογενής, διοτρεφές, αἷμα κελαινόν/μέλαν, ἀργαλέος, ἔμπεδος, ἀμύμων (+ note), δαΐφρων (+ note), θέμις, Αἰακίδης, ἡγήτορες ἠδὲ μέδοντες, πελώριος, βεβλημένος/οὐτάμενοι, κέαται, ἰητήρ, πικρός, ὀδυνήφατος, πάσσε, ἐπέτελλε, οὖρος Ἀχαιῶν, τείρω, ὀξὺν Ἄρηα, ἀντίον ηὔδα and αὖτε προσέειπε formulas, ἦ καί, ποιμένα λαῶν, ἐνίσπω.
- Grammatical labels (ὄρινε, βῆ, θέειν, ἷξε, ἐτετεύχατο, ῥέεν, ἕλκεος, κέαται, σάωσον, ἔκταμ’, δεδιδάχθαι, ἐνίσπω, ὑπέχευε, ἐκτανύσας, τάμνε, διατρίψας, ἐτέρσετο, παύσατο, σχήσουσι, φθίσονται, δαμέντες, μεθήσω, προσέειπε, ἔοι, πεσέονται, ἔσσεται, Πατρόκλεες, ὕπο anastrophe) and positions all checked true; cross-references (1.8, 1.51, 808/813, 819, 829–830, 11.771) true.

## Refused or left open

- **804 στήθεσσιν "breast" vs the table's στῆθος "chest"**: the published iliad-023 line (`l`/`i` "breast") is binding for this repeat. Consequence: στήθεσσιν and στέρνοιο (842) now both read "breast" in this part. Not fixable here; flagged for the table keeper.
- **ἄσειν as "an infinitive of ἄω"**: left vague on purpose; whether it is read as future or aorist infinitive is disputed, and the note makes no false claim.
- **"set off running" for βῆ δὲ θέειν, "I am on my way"**: idiomatic but rebuilt from the grammar (βῆ + infinitive), not a stock phrase; kept.
- **`i` 811 "wet sweat … came gurgling out", `i` 816 "so it was to be, then"**: sense and force agree with `l`; kept.
- **`i` 836 "keen battle"** for ὀξὺν Ἄρηα: table row 2.440; kept.
- **ἤην "singular for the pair of nouns"**: correct (two subjects, verb with the nearer/neuter-like singular); kept.
- **808 ἀγορή … θέμις "settled custom" in `i`**: adds "settled" to the table's "custom" but is explained in new-renderings; the table's own `i` for θέμις is "custom". Left, low; second pass may reconsider.
- **`about`**: "both healers … are out of reach" is loose (Machaon lies wounded, Podalirius is fighting) but not false; kept.

Counts: high 0, medium 8, low 7 (all applied). Refused/open: 7.

## Pass 2 (gloss.json)

Method: every entry read against its line(s) in the Greek and against the unit notes; keys checked against `novel-forms.json` and `iliad-glossary.json`; Attic equivalents, length (<230), ’ only, no line numbers or "here", `__broaden__` = old entry whole + " · " + new reading.

Completeness: all 54 novel forms are accounted for. 44 are in gloss.json as plain entries; 9 (βεβλημένοι, βεβλημένος, κέαται, οὐτάμενοί, παύσατο, ἀργαλέοιο, ἄλκιμος, ἆ, ἐτέρσετο) are already in the glossary and were rightly skipped; ἐσθλά is also there and correctly broadened. (The claim of 10 skipped holds if ἐσθλά is counted.) No extra keys. All nine skipped entries fit their lines except ἀργαλέοιο (below). The other ten `__broaden__` entries start with the old entry whole.

| Entry | Sev | Problem | Done |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἄσειν | medium | "aor. inf." is doubtful: after ἐμέλλετε the future infinitive is the regular construction, and the aorist infinitive of ἄω is ἆσαι; no Attic equivalent named | "fut. inf. (the aor. inf. is ἆσαι), after ἐμέλλετε"; Attic uses κορέννυμι. Unit note left vague (it claims only "an infinitive of ἄω") |
| περιπευκές | medium | "sharp all round" contradicts the unit note at 845 (περι- "very") | "very sharp, keen (περι- intensive; root of ἐχεπευκής)" |
| ἀργαλέοιο | medium | the glossary entry says "masc. gen. sg." only; at 812 it agrees with neuter ἕλκεος | `__broaden__` added: old entry + " · also neut. gen. sg., agreeing with ἕλκεος: ’grievous (wound)’" |
| δεδιδάχθαι | low | said the source stands "in the gen." governed by the verb; Ἀχιλλῆος is governed by προτί | "the teacher given by προτί + gen." |
| νότιος | low | homograph νότιος "southern" not excluded | added "not νότιος ’southern’" |
| ἔκταμ | low | no Attic equivalent | "= ἔκταμε; Attic ἔκτεμε" |
| ὑπέχευε | low | epic aorist ἔχευε not named as such, no Attic equivalent | "epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ὑπέχεε)" |

Checked and sound: προτί (πρός + gen. of the source; Attic equivalent named), φθίσονται (future middle of φθίνω, φθίσομαι; the aorist-subjunctive reading is not needed), and every other parse (σχήσουσι, μεθήσω, ἐμέλλετε, ἐτετεύχατο, ἐνίσπω, ταχέας, τειρομένοιο, μαχαίρῃ, ἀργέτι, χρηΐζοντα, κελάρυζε, νίζ’ at 830 and 846, etc.). units.json not changed.

Counts (pass 2): high 0, medium 3, low 4, all applied. Refused: none; the ἄσειν future-vs-aorist question is settled in the gloss only.
